layers.name: TIMELINE_ORCHESTRATION
layers.purpose: Decide the shot sequence, per-shot start/end times and chapter structure the whole documentary is built on.
layers.output: shot_manifest.json (shot_id, chapter, start_time, end_time, narration, renderer)
layers.timeline_responsibility: authoritative source of every other layer's timing

layers.name: PURE_CODE_VISUALS
layers.purpose: Data-driven code-rendered visuals: counters, bar charts, comparison diagrams, institution icons. Semantic role: PROVE.
layers.timeline_responsibility: fills shot slots assigned by TIMELINE_ORCHESTRATION / L05 visual routing
layers.render_compositing_method: Remotion React/TS/SVG render to silent mp4, muxed with narration downstream by COMPOSITING_TRANSITIONS
layers.current_configuration: 25/31 shots (shot_manifest renderer=pure_code); data_manifest visualization_type in {counter, bar_chart, diagram}

layers.name: THREEJS_VISUALS
layers.purpose: Genuinely spatial 3D diagrams (Treasury -> bond market -> holder categories). Semantic role: UNDERSTAND.
layers.responsible_script: apps/api/app/pipeline/hft_threejs.py (drives the existing persistent three.js/Node/Puppeteer worker in threejs_engine.py)
layers.render_compositing_method: three.js worker render -> encode, muxed downstream

layers.name: REAL_FOOTAGE
layers.purpose: Sourced stock footage grounding claims in real-world imagery. Semantic role: TRUST.
layers.timeline_responsibility: shot slots per asset_manifest.json (h3, w1, w4, e2)
layers.render_compositing_method: sourced footage, verified by frame inspection per qa_report.md, muxed downstream

layers.name: REAL_IMAGE
layers.purpose: Real document/photo stills (e.g. an actual Treasury security). Semantic role: TRUST.
layers.timeline_responsibility: originally slotted for m1; superseded there by PAPER_COLLAGE per scripts/render_national_debt_collage_v1.py ("m1 TREASURY/BORROWING (was real_image, thematically loose)") -- shot_manifest.json's renderer field for m1 is stale relative to the V2+ assembly
layers.current_configuration: 0 shots active in the current V2+ assembly (superseded by PAPER_COLLAGE at m1); retained as a proven engine, not deleted
layers.status: ACTIVE (engine proven, currently unused in this episode's assembled timeline)

layers.name: SKETCH_RENDERER
layers.purpose: Hand-drawn-style animated visuals for conceptual/mental-model beats. Semantic role: UNDERSTAND.
layers.timeline_responsibility: shot slots c1, co2, d5, m2 (approved replacements for former PURE_CODE renders)
layers.render_compositing_method: standalone benchmark render, slotted into the timeline by L05 Visual Director / build_14layer_v2.py

layers.name: VECTOR_RENDERER
layers.purpose: Flat vector-motion visuals (flat-emission + inverted-hull-outline technique). Semantic role: UNDERSTAND.
layers.timeline_responsibility: shot slots c2, co3, d4, m3
layers.render_compositing_method: Blender render, slotted into the timeline by L05 Visual Director / build_14layer_v2.py

layers.name: PAPER_COLLAGE_RENDERER
layers.purpose: Premium-editorial paper-collage visuals for historical/thematic beats. Semantic role: UNDERSTAND (thematic/editorial variant).
layers.timeline_responsibility: shot slots c4, cj1, i1, m1 (m1 supersedes the original REAL_IMAGE assignment)
layers.render_compositing_method: standalone benchmark render, slotted into the timeline by L05 Visual Director / build_14layer_v2.py

layers.name: PIKA_AI_INSERTS
layers.purpose: AI-generated video inserts for emotionally-grounding illustrative moments the other engines can't source cleanly. Semantic role: FEEL.
layers.input: pika_footage/* (6 approved clips of 7 discovered; 1 rejected for garbled on-screen text)
layers.render_compositing_method: ffmpeg overlay segment-replacement with baked alpha cross-dissolves (0.25-0.50s); audio copied verbatim from V3
layers.current_configuration: 4 inserts, 25.93s total AI screen time (~4.88% of 531.9s)
layers.status: ACTIVE / FROZEN (approved, not to be regenerated or re-audited)

layers.name: NARRATION_VOICE
layers.purpose: TTS voiceover -- the spine every other layer's timing derives from.
layers.render_compositing_method: TTS synthesis, one file per shot
layers.current_configuration: 31 narration lines, audio confirmed byte-identical (MD5 ea7fceeeffd0813f9f0c70db61c8b6bb) across V2/V3/V3-Pika/both fullcaptions renders

layers.name: MUSIC_BED
layers.purpose: Per-chapter music beds with crossfades, ducked under narration/SFX.
layers.input: music_manifest.json (chapter, bed file, start/end, gain_db, crossfade_sec)
layers.output: music_bed_mix*.wav, muxed into the final audio stream
layers.timeline_responsibility: chapter-aligned beds spanning the full runtime
layers.render_compositing_method: gain-staged mix with 2.0s crossfades between chapter beds

layers.name: SFX
layers.purpose: Discrete sound effects tied to specific visual events (impacts, counter climbs, reveals).
layers.input: sfx_manifest.json + _v3_sfx_cues.json (visual_event, asset, gain, shot_id, start_time, duration)
layers.output: muxed into the final audio stream
layers.render_compositing_method: per-asset gain-compensated mix (~-13..-17dB effective peak), narration always at unity

layers.name: FULL_CAPTION_SYSTEM
layers.purpose: Continuous, full-transcript narration captions across the entire runtime (CURRENT, authoritative typography/caption layer).
layers.responsible_script: data/jobs/k70_national_debt_ep01/14layer_v3_pika_fullcaptions/build_fullcaptions.py (cue rendering) + build_fullcaptions_clean.py (source-level clean composite: V2 + reused Pika inserts + reused caption clips)
layers.timeline_responsibility: 131 cues covering 99.12% of narration span across all 31 shots
layers.render_compositing_method: PIL-rendered Georgia-serif PNG->qtrle mov per cue (halo + gradient scrim, band=upper for h1/d3, lower elsewhere), ffmpeg overlay chain, single-pass composite over V2
layers.current_configuration: 131 cues, 31/31 shots, 99.12% narration coverage, 0 intra-shot gaps >0.05s

layers.name: COMPOSITING_TRANSITIONS
layers.purpose: The assembly glue: crossfade/transition grammar between shots, overlay chains stitching every visual layer together, final video/audio mux and output encode spec.
layers.input: all rendered shot .mp4s (L02-L08), PIKA_AI_INSERTS, FULL_CAPTION_SYSTEM cues, mixed audio (L10-L12)
layers.timeline_responsibility: 0.5s cross-dissolve grammar between shots (no stacked digital zoom); Pika alpha cross-dissolves 0.25-0.50s; output spec 1920x1080, 30fps, h264 (crf16-18), aac, +faststart
layers.render_compositing_method: ffmpeg filter_complex overlay/xfade chains, -c:a copy for audio, libx264 for video

deprecated_components.name: OLD_SELECTIVE_CAPTIONS
deprecated_components.former_layer_role: was the L10/Typography caption layer prior to FULL_CAPTION_SYSTEM (L13)
deprecated_components.reason: superseded by FULL_CAPTION_SYSTEM (L13, 131 cues / 99.12% coverage vs. 18 selective phrase cues); must never automatically return
deprecated_components.note: the 18 old cues remain physically baked into V3/V3-Pika/V3-Pika-Fullcaptions(non-clean) pixels -- those files are protected masters and are not edited retroactively; the _clean master rebuilds from the pre-caption V2 master specifically to exclude them at the source
